question: Which earth radius does globalgrid2050 architecture development use for distance in kilometres?
decision: Distance takes its radius from the engine's named radii (R_ATLAS, R_UK, R_MEAN in geo-core.js), chosen by purpose; no bare number is written anywhere else.
rationale: Two values are in use (6371.0088 and 6378.137). Neither is wrong; they serve different purposes. The engine already names them by purpose, so the decision is to import, never to copy.

agents_may: Replace any bare earth radius with an import from geo-core.js.
Generate apps that take the radius from the engine block Gc.

note: This is the example only: id d000 is never a real record. Real records start at d001.
